note: The one canonical mail allowlist: the mailboxes a capture scope may name one by one (integrations/capture_mail refuses a named mailbox outside this list; tenant-wide capture of every directory mailbox minus an explicit exclusion list, ING-06, is configured in integrations/mail_capture_scope.json and does not depend on this list) and whose mail may enter a case (ING-13, WS-08). Reported Graph mail allowlist at petrasoap.com, enforced upstream by the Exchange application access policy group graph-portal-mailscope@petrasoap.com. Only status 'reported_allowlisted' is in scope; 'pending_confirmation' stays out until confirmed (fail closed). Personal mailboxes (ricardo, vince) are listed because the allowlist lists them (use only allowlisted mailboxes). This file grants nothing: a reader still needs the live-source audience (and, for an employee, mailbox ownership) to read any message.
